card.fires_on: Words leading into a statistical method or specification, such as "stratified", "pre-specified", "Estimated using a" before a Cox model or hazard ratio. Fires on the middle of these words or the small words just before the method term.

modes.label: Stratified or pre-specified

modes.label: Estimated using a model
modes.description: Small words after "Estimated" or "using" that introduce a Cox proportional hazards model.
